note: Three workload profiles to score against the documented capability flags. Edit the requirement keys to describe your own workload; the script only checks documented support, never measured latency or price.

profiles.description: Interactive coding session: keep the workspace and its in-memory state between user turns, resume many times a day, no long-running job.
Bounded code execution per request with cleanup afterwards; state between calls is not needed.
Agent that idles for hours or days between jobs and must resume with the process memory it had, but must also be able to park a finished job as filesystem-only storage.
